findings.title: Worn painted avatars are clipped by their circle and sized inconsistently (fox ears, crane wings, lamp head, dragon tail cut; cat and lantern float small)

findings.title: Worn painted frames leave a dark empty band between the avatar and the ring (the ring's hole is ~75% of the art, the avatar is drawn at 66%)

findings.fix: Store each frame's measured hole ratio and centre offset in the catalogue (e.g. hole:0.75, cx/cy) and size the art as avatarOuter / hole (≈133%, not 152%) positioned by its hole centre; let the art cover the HP ring instead of sitting outside it, or re-key the art so every hole is a centred circle of one fixed ratio.

findings.title: Washi Morning (light shop theme, 1,500 gold) keeps the dark-ground red: every overdue/alarm text is 3.2:1 on its cards
findings.evidence: eval resolving each token inside a [data-theme] probe: washi-morning --red 3.23, --alarm 3.23 vs atelier-dawn 5.78; themes4.json washi-morning alarmOnS1 3.23; css/themes.css:850-866 (washi block, no --red) vs :93 (Dawn's --red); grep 'color: var(--alarm)' css -> 61 rules
findings.rootCause: Only Dawn was treated as a light theme when the fixed status colours were tuned; the newer light theme copied the role overrides but not the light-ground status restatement.
findings.fix: Give washi-morning the same light-ground --red restatement as Dawn (and check --red-soft/--crit washes derive from it); add a smoke check that every theme's --alarm on --s1 is >= 4.5:1.

findings.title: Picture drawer 'Rotate by season / time of day' ignores what the pictures are: First snow never shows in winter, the rooftop and First snow never show at all, the night train shows at 2 pm
findings.evidence: eval: setCfg('focus',{mode:'rotate',period:'season'}) rotated for 15 Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct -> library/train/shrine/cafe; period 'tod' 8/14/19/23h -> library/train/shrine/cafe; condition mode with period 'day' -> 'by the day'; js/core/art.js:131-137 (index by position), js/modules/artslot.js:65 (period hidden in condition mode) and :73 ('Otherwise the season decides')
findings.rootCause: Rotation treats the pool as an anonymous list; only Home's four seasonal heroes happen to line up with SEASONS order.
findings.fix: Give each scene/hall catalogue item its own season and time-of-day tags (snow: winter + evening, rooftop/train: night, library: afternoon...) and rotate among the owned pictures that match, falling back to all; set period 'season' when switching to condition mode (or show the period there).

findings.title: Edit your seat > Background offers '+ Upload an image' with 0 gold and no unlock, bypassing the 3,000-gold 'Profile banner' unlock (invariant 2)
findings.evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/b4/empty-edit-bg-upload.png; eval on empty account: {gold:0, ownsBanner:false, canUpload:false, uploadBtn:true}; js/modules/governor-ui.js:743-758 (no canUpload check), js/core/governor.js:930-934 (setCustomBanner -> bannerCropper(source)), :920-922 (allowUpload only hides the in-dialog button); js/core/art.js:60-63,85-99 (art.own.<slot> kv store)
findings.rootCause: The unlock was added to the drawer and the banner cropper's own button, not to the older Edit-seat upload path that feeds the same banner.
findings.fix: Gate the tile on KOS.art.canUpload('banner') (show the lock with 'Open in the shop' otherwise, as the drawer does) and make the drawer's 'Your own' banner and g.bannerImg one store.

findings.title: 'Try anything on before you buy' is not true for 65 of the items (avatars, frames, seals, banners, shelf skins, Shrine cards, papers, pen sets: 34,060 gold)
findings.evidence: js/modules/governor-ui.js:1013 (promise text), :1039 (canTry exclusions), :1089-1090 (sheet Try on only for outfit/scene/hall/finish/theme); js/core/governor.js:826-831 (tryItem returns unless theme or WEAR kind), :805 (WEAR); eval: 65 non-retired items, 34,060 gold
findings.fix: Either extend the transient try-on to the profile kinds (frame/avatar/seal/banner on the stage's identity block; shelf/Shrine card on a sample row) or change the copy to name what can be tried.

findings.title: Exam and Sketch pen sets barely differ from the default, label their swatches wrongly, and silently recolour every stroke already written
findings.evidence: eval KOS.inkUI.palette(host) after KOS.governor.wear('penset', id): default/study identical; exam {accent:'rgb(232,95,97)',teal:'rgb(131,134,142)'}; sketch {ink:'rgb(180,183,190)',accent:'rgb(230,169,197)',teal:'rgb(235,197,115)',amber:'rgb(230,181,93)',bloom:'rgb(230,169,197)'}; css/views/ink.css:37-42; js/core/inkui.js:1265-1266 (aria-label/title from PEN_ROLES names); js/core/ink.js:56 (PEN_ROLES)
findings.rootCause: Pen sets were implemented as CSS remaps of the shared roles on :root rather than as new roles.
findings.fix: Give each set distinct colours and its own swatch names (Pen/Red pen/Pencil; Graphite/Wash/Highlight) and apply the set to NEW strokes only (store the resolved set on the stroke, or have the set add roles rather than remap existing ones).

findings.title: 'Kurenai bloom' frame (◈90) renders as eight blocky pink squares, not petals
findings.evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/b3/frames-2x.png (frame-crimson); css/layout.css:272-274
findings.rootCause: Conic-gradient approximation of petals.
findings.fix: Retire the four CSS frames (as the CSS banners were) now that painted frames exist, or redraw the bloom as an SVG petal mask.

findings.title: Two outfit descriptions do not match their art: 'Day off' promises a soft cardigan (art: a hoodie), 'Exam season' a blazer and lanyard (art: grey cardigan and glasses, no lanyard)

findings.title: Edit your seat: the aria-hidden preview still holds three keyboard-focusable buttons (Study, Rest rhythm, 'Open full log ->'); Enter on the last leaves the editor and drops the draft

findings.title: Empty Wardrobe and Theme card waste most of the page: 12 cells of 'In the Gold Shop ->' with 120px gaps, a 2-card Theme row on a 1,200px card, and 'Rotate or your own' offered for kinds you own none of
findings.evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/b4/empty-avatar-mac.png, b4/empty-avatar-mac-top.png, b4/empty-avatar-iphone.png; js/modules/governor-ui.js:1415 (unowned chip -> KOS.show('governor','shop') with no department), :1450

findings.title: A locked lab sends you to the top of the shop with no Buy here, never says it unlocks the whole Trace Lab, and repeats '180' on four cards
findings.evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/shop-cosmetics/b4/empty-sims-locked.png, b4/empty-sim-locked-open.png; js/core/governor.js:596-626 (KOS.show('governor','shop') with no department; dead isHp branch; grep why:'hp' -> no producer); js/modules/governor-ui.js:849 (shopSel module var, no route arg)

findings.title: Gold is drawn with two different glyphs: ◈ in the Gold Shop, ◆ in the HUD, Seat, labs and rewards

findings.title: Every shop action (Buy, Use, Take off, Try on, Pin) rebuilds the whole shop and drops keyboard focus to <main>
findings.evidence: eval mac and iphone: click [data-ui~=shop.use] -> scroll before/after stage=9285/9285 (mac), 15438/15438 (iphone); focus after: MAIN; js/modules/governor-ui.js:1041,1045,1053,1057 (each onclick ends in render())
